description: Call ANY Grafana HTTP API endpoint directly on the tenant's Grafana connection (covers the full API surface). Required: method (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE|PATCH), path (relative to /api, with leading slash, e.g. '/search', '/dashboards/uid/abc'). Optional: body (object), query (object → query string). Use the named grafana_* tools for common resources; use this for anything else. Secrets stay server-side.

body.description: JSON request body sent to the API

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE or PATCH

path.description: Grafana API path relative to /api with leading slash, e.g. '/search'

name: grafana_request
